jobs.title: Tableau Developer
responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain Tableau dashboards and reports based on business requirements
Work with large datasets and build interactive visualizations for business insights
Connect Tableau with multiple data sources such as SQL databases, data warehouses, and cloud platforms
Optimize dashboards for performance, scalability, and usability
Develop calculated fields, parameters, filters, and Tableau data models
Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver analytical solutions
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and governance in reporting solutions
Troubleshoot and resolve dashboard performance and data issues

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
responsibilities: Design and manage AI infrastructure and related pipelines
Build scalable systems including inference services, data pipelines, and evaluation pipelines
Lead or contribute to DevOps practices, cloud deployment (e.g., AWS/GCP), and system monitoring
Ensure reliability, scalability, and performance in production environments
Design, build, and maintain production-ready AI systems
Participate in the full lifecycle: prototyping → evaluation → deployment → scaling → monitoring
Architect and implement multi-agent workflows
Design prompt strategies, tool usage, memory systems, and planning mechanisms
Select appropriate models and approaches based on engineering constraints (performance, latency, cost)
Contribute to fine-tuning or adapting open-source models when needed
Build stable evaluation and iteration frameworks to continuously improve system performance
Work closely with product, research, and deployment teams
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical direction
Translate ambiguous requirements into robust engineering solutions

jobs.title: Business Analyst (Salesforce / Workday)
responsibilities: Facilitate workshops and interviews with stakeholders to identify and document business needs, pain points, and process improvements.
Design and maintain detailed "As-Is" and "To-Be" business process diagrams.
Collaborate with frontend engineers to define clean, versioned REST & gRPC contracts.
Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for the technical team.
Work closely with developers and configuration specialists to ensure the solution meets the defined business needs.
Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including the creation of test scripts and management of defect resolution.
Develop training materials and provide support to end-users during system deployments and updates.
Analyze system data to provide insights and recommendations for ongoing optimization

jobs.title: Environment Manager (Salesforce / Workday)
responsibilities: Define and maintain a robust environment strategy, including sandbox management, refreshes, and tenant mapping for Salesforce and Workday.
Oversee the end-to-end deployment pipeline, ensuring that all code and configuration changes move through the environment stack without conflict.
Implement and manage automated deployment tools (e.g., Copado, Gearset, Flosum, or Workday Object Transporter) to improve speed and reliability.
Coordinate data masking and seeding strategies to ensure developers and testers have high-quality, compliant data in non-production environments.
Act as the primary gatekeeper for production, collaborating with Scrum Masters, BAs, and Developers to resolve environment contention issues.
Ensure all environments comply with organizational security standards, managing user access and monitoring system health across all instances.
Track environment uptime and performance metrics, proactively identifying bottlenecks in the release lifecycle.

jobs.title: Scrum Master (Salesforce / Workday)
responsibilities: Lead all Scrum ceremonies, including Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives for Salesforce/Workday development teams.
Proactively identify and eliminate "roadblocks" (technical, resource-based, or process-related) that hinder the team’s progress.
Partner with Product Managers and Business Analysts to ensure the backlog is healthy, prioritized, and ready for upcoming sprints.
Utilize tools like Jira or Azure DevOps to track velocity, burn-down charts, and sprint health, providing transparent reporting to stakeholders.
Guide the team on Agile best practices and self-organization, specifically tailored to the unique constraints of SaaS platforms (e.g., deployment cycles and sandbox limitations).
Protect the team from outside interruptions and "scope creep" during active sprints.
Collaborate with Environment Managers to align sprint goals with release windows and deployment schedules.

jobs.title: MS SQL Data Analyst
responsibilities: Write and optimize complex T-SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and functions to extract data from large healthcare databases.
Conduct deep-dive data analysis to identify inconsistencies, missing values, or anomalies in patient, billing, or clinical records.
Collaborate with stakeholders to design and automate recurring reports, ensuring accuracy in healthcare KPIs (e.g., patient outcomes, readmission rates).
Perform source-to-target mapping for data migration or integration projects between different healthcare systems (e.g., EMR/EHR platforms).
Monitor and optimize query performance to handle high-volume datasets efficiently.
Ensure all data handling and analysis strictly adhere to healthcare data privacy regulations (HIPAA) and client-specific security protocols.
Present data findings to non-technical healthcare administrators and clinical staff in a clear, concise manner.
